Reason for Mistake: After WebSurfer surfaced an authoritative Halliburton source (the 2021 Annual & Sustainability Report) stating the company “served customers in more than 70 countries,” plus corroborating third-party references (e.g., Wikipedia), the Planner continued to issue near-identical search instructions instead of synthesizing and finalizing the answer.
